description: Delivery status and receipt of a send_fax job. status is queued, working, delivered, failed or expired; keep checking about every 20 seconds until it is delivered, failed or expired. A busy, unanswered or dropped call is retried automatically up to three more times over about 17 minutes while the status stays working; attempts, max_attempts and next_attempt_at say where it is. A failed or expired fax carries failure_category, failure_reason, retryable, refund and a plain failure_message saying what happened.
name: get_fax
title: Check a fax
